title: Canyons Endurance Runs by UTMB — 2026 schedule of events
publisher: UTMB World Series / Canyons Endurance Runs by UTMB
claims: The 2026 schedule listed the first 100K shuttle to China Wall at 02:45 and the last at 03:45, both from Gold Country Fairgrounds Parking.
The 2026 schedule stated that there was no 100K race-morning bib pick-up and no drop-bag drop-off at China Wall; bib pick-up was at the corner of E. Placer and High Street.
The page labels the schedule as 2026 and says it will be updated for 2027; no 2027 shuttle times are published.
